description_zh: 该接口用于提交认证材料以进行核实比对，并同步返回认证结果

name: ContrastFaceVerify

parameters.help_en: The ID of the authentication scenario
parameters.name: scene_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the merchant request. The value is a 32-character alphanumeric string. The first few characters are a custom abbreviation of the merchant, the middle part can be a period of time, and the last part can be a random or incremental sequence
parameters.help_zh:
商户请求的唯一标识。
值为32位长度的字母数字组合。前面几位字符是商户自定义的简称，中间可以使用一段时间，后段可以使用一个随机或递增序列
parameters.name: outer_order_no

parameters.help_en: The product code. Set the value to ID_MIN
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The type of the ID document. Only ID cards are supported. Set the value to IDENTITY_CARD
parameters.help_zh:
证件类型。
当前支持身份证，必须传入IDENTITY_CARD
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en: The device token for risk identification
parameters.name: device_token

parameters.help_en: The mobile phone number of the user
parameters.name: mobile

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the user
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The custom user ID in the customer's business system
parameters.help_zh: 客户业务自定义的用户ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the photo in OSS. Only authorized OSS photo URLs are supported.

You can use only one of the following methods to upload the image: FaceContrastPicture, FaceContrastPictureUrl, CertifyId, and OSS
parameters.help_zh:
OSS照片地址，目前只支持已授权OSS照片地址。

在FaceContrastPicture、FaceContrastPictureUrl、CertifyId、OSS四种传入图片方式中，选择其中一种传入即可
parameters.name: face_contrast_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The CertifyId of a previous successful ID Verification. The photo used in the previous verification is used as the comparison photo.

You can use only one of the following methods to upload the image: FaceContrastPicture, FaceContrastPictureUrl, CertifyId, and OSS
parameters.help_zh:
之前实人认证通过的CertifyId，认证时的照片作为比对照片。

在FaceContrastPicture、FaceContrastPictureUrl、CertifyId、OSS四种传入图片方式中，选择其中一种传入即可
parameters.name: certify_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the authorized OSS bucket.

You can use only one of the following methods to upload the image: FaceContrastPicture, FaceContrastPictureUrl, CertifyId, and OSS
parameters.help_zh:
已授权OSS空间的Bucket 名 。

在FaceContrastPicture、FaceContrastPictureUrl、CertifyId、OSS四种传入图片方式中，选择其中一种传入即可
parameters.name: oss_bucket_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the object in the authorized OSS bucket.

You can use only one of the following methods to upload the image: FaceContrastPicture, FaceContrastPictureUrl, CertifyId, and OSS
parameters.help_zh:
已授权OSS空间的文件名。

在FaceContrastPicture、FaceContrastPictureUrl、CertifyId、OSS四种传入图片方式中，选择其中一种传入即可
parameters.name: oss_object_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow cropping of the face image. Valid values:
T: Cropping is allowed.
F: Cropping is not allowed. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许裁剪人脸图片：

T：允许剪裁

F（默认）：不允许剪裁
parameters.name: crop

parameters.help_en: The encryption type. An empty value indicates that encryption is not used
parameters.help_zh: 加密类型。为空表示不加密
parameters.name: encrypt_type

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success, and other values indicate failure
Code.description_zh: 返回码：200为成功，其他为失败

CertifyId.description_en: The unique identifier of the ID Verification request
CertifyId.description_zh: 实人认证请求的唯一标识

IdentityInfo.description_en: The information of the authenticated subject. This parameter is empty in common authentication scenarios
IdentityInfo.description_zh: 认证的主体信息，一般的认证场景返回为空

MaterialInfo.description_en: The attachment information of the authenticated subject, which mainly includes image materials. The value is in JSON format as follows
MaterialInfo.description_zh: 认证主体附件信息，主要为图片类材料，JSON格式，如下

Passed.description_en: Indicates whether the verification is passed. A value of T indicates that the verification is passed, and a value of F indicates that the verification fails
Passed.description_zh: 是否通过，通过为T，不通过为F

SubCode.description_en: The description of the authentication result. For more information, see the SubCode description below
SubCode.description_zh: 认证结果描述。详情见下方SubCode 说明
